name: 26-malformed-goal-is-rejected
description: A malformed induction goal (an `eq` node with no `slots`) must be rejected as a bad request, never crash the backend or produce a grade. Pins the protocol invariant 'malformed MathNodes -> 400 / exit 2 with {error}' across all four backends — it previously held only for eggregate, while cvc5regate crashed with an uncaught KeyError (exit 1 / 500).
